svg.title: Export a report, and send it on a schedule — SoftTrack web design mockup (#333)
svg.desc: Any report downloads as the CSV behind its chart, with names rather than ids and typed text made safe to open, and as the SVG it is drawn as. A saved report can be emailed weekly, every two weeks or monthly through the subscriptions of #285, built per reader so nobody receives a team they cannot read.

svg.text: Done when any report, saved or not, downloads as CSV (one row per group, or per group and interval, names not ids, safe_text for typed text, numbers as numbers, the name and
date in the filename) and as SVG; when a saved report can be subscribed to through #285, by its owner if private and by any member if shared, with a team admin able to
subscribe the team; when each email is built per recipient; and when nothing is offered without SMTP.
